name: getConfluenceContent
description:
REQUIRED: Supply at least one content locator: content_id or content_url.
Read any Confluence content (page, blog, live doc, comment, whiteboard, embed, database, folder).

cloudId.description: Site UUID or Jira/Confluence URL for this operation's Atlassian site. cloudId is never silently auto-resolved or reused for you — call getAccessibleAtlassianResources ONCE per session, cache the returned cloudId, and pass it explicitly on this and every subsequent call, since most operations need it. `execute` and its read/write/destructive variants strictly require it for cloudId-scoped operations and fail without it. Not needed for cloudId-less operations (e.g. Bitbucket), which ignore this field.

content_id.description:
Required when content_url is omitted. Numeric Confluence content ID, or a
Confluence tiny link key (the encoded part
from /wiki/x/ URLs, e.g. 4_sXAQ). Recognized Confluence content URLs are also
accepted and converted to the content ID, but prefer content_url for URLs.
One of content_id or content_url is required.

content_url.description:
Required when content_id is omitted. Full URL of the Confluence content.
Supported: pages/live docs
(/pages/{id}), blog URLs (/blog/{id}), whiteboards
(/whiteboard/{id}), databases (/database/{id}), folders (/folder/{id}),
and TinyUrl (/wiki/x/{key}). Prefer this for URLs copied from Confluence.
One of content_id or content_url is required.

detail.description:
Response shape for document-style reads. summary = title + excerpt + counts
(default, cheap). ai_summary = the generated AI summary when available, otherwise
null; it does not fall back to the standard excerpt. outline = heading tree (cheap,
for navigation). full = body in the requested format (use when intending to edit).
Non-document content such as whiteboards, databases, folders, and embeds does not support detail;
content_format is a separate representation selector for
formats such as whiteboard svg/png, database csv, or embed url.

content_format.description:
Body format. Doc types: html (default) or markdown. Document HTML can contain
supported macro wrappers instead of content displayed in Confluence web. When
visible macro content is required, use resolveConfluenceContentMacros with the
returned numeric content ID and all=true; use discover if its full contract is
needed. Whiteboards: svg or png (png is read-only and returns a short-lived
presigned URL to the file in body.value, not the image content). Databases: csv.
URL-backed content such as embeds: url.

draft.description:
If true, read the draft version instead of current. Only supported for
pages and blog posts.
